reason: Candidate C1 is the strongest hypothesis because it directly addresses the specific system (AlCoCrFeNi eutectic HEA) and the specific failure mode (interfacial cracking due to stress concentration) by proposing a concrete, physically consistent mechanism: transforming coarse lamellae into a coherent, ultra-fine nanolamellar structure (<100 nm) to promote dislocation transmission rather than accumulation. It provides precise, quantified predictions (UTS >1.2 GPa, elongation >20%, spacing reduction) and defines a rigorous falsification experiment that isolates the 'high-intensity' deformation variable by comparing it against a conventional Hot Isostatic Pressing (HIP) control.
